page: OVHcloud t2-le-45 is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Cloud GPU family. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6226R processor with 15 physical cores and 15 vCPUs running at 2.9 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 45 GB of RAM, providing 3.0 GB of memory per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Volta V100S GPU with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 300 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps along with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate average tier results for standard CPU and memory operations, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1224.0 and a multi-core score of 9126.0. However, the integrated NVIDIA V100S GPU delivers top-tier performance in specific workloads. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier prompt processing speeds of 19245.13 tokens per second for a small 135M model and 1434.01 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. Text generation for the 7B model also reaches a top-tier rate of 124.44 tokens per second. Conversely, prompt processing for a large 70B model drops to an average tier of 14.88 tokens per second, reflecting hardware limitations when handling larger model parameters.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the t2-le-45 offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated computing by pairing dedicated legacy Intel Xeon cores with a high-VRAM Volta GPU. This configuration avoids the higher costs associated with newer-generation GPU architectures while maintaining sufficient memory density for medium-scale AI workloads. This server is highly suited for machine learning inference, medium-sized LLM deployment, data science pipelines, and parallelized compute tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and GPU acceleration.
